Author: Okafor, Ada; Lindqvist, Sven
Title: Sparse Attention for Long Document Retrieval
Abstract Note: We study retrieval over long documents and propose a sparse attention scheme that reduces memory use while preserving ranking quality.

Author: Tanaka, Hiro; Moreau, Ines; Haddad, Omar
Title: Graph Pooling with Learned Cluster Assignments
Abstract Note:
Pooling operators for graph neural networks often discard structure.
We learn soft cluster assignments that keep "community" structure intact.

Author: Petrov, Dmitri; Silva, Grace
Title: Client Drift in Federated Averaging
Abstract Note: Local updates on heterogeneous clients cause drift. We analyse its effect on convergence and propose a simple correction.

Author: Kowalski, Quinn; Nguyen, Mei
Title: Counterfactual Explanations under Hidden Confounding
Abstract Note: Counterfactual explanations assume no unmeasured confounders. We show when that assumption fails and bound the resulting error.

Author: Abernathy, Rosa; Castillo, Tariq; Ivanova, Uma
Title: Certified Robustness for Recommender Embeddings
Abstract Note: User embeddings in recommender systems can be shifted by a few poisoned interactions. We give certified bounds on that shift.

Author: Mensah, Wen; Fischer, Yara
Title: Patch Tokenization for Irregular Time Series Forecasting
Abstract Note: Irregular sampling breaks standard forecasting models. Patch tokenization over observed windows handles missing values without imputation.

Author: Rao, Zane; Larsen, Amara
Title: Calibrated Uncertainty for Forecasting with Gaussian Processes
Abstract Note: Gaussian processes give principled uncertainty, but calibration degrades on long horizons. We recalibrate predictive intervals post hoc.
